definitions.explanation: Indicates that something has not yet been officially verified or identified. Common in news reporting and official communications, as in the well-known compound 未確認飛行物体 (UFO).

examples.japanese: {未確認|みかくにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧です。
{未確認|みかくにん}{飛行|ひこう}{物体|ぶったい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目撃|もくげき}→目撃：13627_mokugeki⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: An unidentified flying object was spotted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{全容|ぜんよう}→全容：11659_zenyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{未確認|みかくにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ままだ。
examples.english: The full extent of the damage remains unconfirmed.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{未|み}→未〜：00277_mi⟧ (not yet) and ⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧ (confirmation). Used as a noun modifier to indicate that something has not been verified or identified. Common in news reporting, official communications, and formal writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {未確認|みかくにん}⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧: unconfirmed information/report
- {未確認|みかくにん}{飛行|ひこう}{物体|ぶったい}: unidentified flying object (UFO)
- {未確認|みかくにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま: remaining unconfirmed
- {未確認|みかくにん}⟦{生物|せいぶつ}→生物：03295_seibutsu⟧: unidentified creature (UMA)

FORMS:
The prefix ⟦{未|み}→未〜：00277_mi⟧～ indicates "not yet" and attaches to many two-kanji compounds:
- ⟦{未|み}{完成|かんせい}→未完成：13066_mikansei⟧: incomplete
- ⟦{未|み}{解決|かいけつ}→未解決：17292_mikaiketsu⟧: unsolved
- ⟦{未|み}{経験|けいけん}→未経験：17726_mikeiken⟧: inexperienced
